Questions about getting in touch

Who answers when I call Dominion AI Agency?

An AI receptionist answers the main line 24 hours a day, every day. It can tell you about our services and prices, answer common questions and take a message for Maurice. That is on purpose: hearing it handle your questions tells you more than any page on this site. If you want a person, say so and it will take your details for a call back.

What should I put in the form?

Your name, your business name, an email address, and a sentence or two about what you want automated, for example "we miss calls after 5 p.m." or "we want a chat on our website that books estimates". A phone number is optional. We reply by email or phone. The form is not a way to send text messages, and we do not text you from it.

Do you have an office I can visit?

No. Dominion AI Agency is based in East Texas but works remotely with businesses in all 50 states, and the address is not public. Everything happens by phone, email and shared screens, and nothing we set up requires a visit to your location.

Can I get a quote before I call?

Our prices are published. Packages are $597, $1,097 and $1,997 a month, and single services start at $97 a month. The pricing page lists what each includes. Tell us in the form which one you are looking at, and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Rather hear it than read about it? Call the main line

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
